verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented batch or bulk payout API that pushes many stablecoin or fiat disbursements in one operation with per-item status. CPN covers individual cross-border fiat payouts, and developer-controlled wallets are described as being 'for payouts,' but neither mentions mass disbursement. The Gateway 'batch processing of EIP-3009 authorizations' endpoint is an adjacent settlement primitive, not a documented mass-payout operation with per-item status, so it earns no credit.
